title: 7. VirusTotal — Hash Lookup Workflow
objective: Study-guide review — ICCS423 v2 — L21: Threat Intelligence & MITRE ATT&CK: 7. VirusTotal — Hash Lookup Workflow.

blocks.text: VirusTotal (virustotal.com) aggregates 70+ AV engines, sandbox runs, and community intelligence.
How to interpret a VT result

rows: e.g. 58/72 — number of engines flagging it. >5/72 → likely malicious
If first-seen is recent + low detection → fresh sample, possibly targeted
Sandbox shows file/registry/network activity — DNS queries, dropped files, processes spawned
Files dropped, contacted IPs/URLs, files that contain this hash
Analyst comments, Yara rules, sandbox screenshots
Mapped ATT&CK techniques observed during sandboxing

items: Suspicious file on endpoint → compute SHA-256
Search VT — never upload sensitive samples (uploads are public to subscribers)
High ratio + known family → malware confirmed → IR
Low ratio + unusual behavior → possible 0-day/targeted → escalate
0/72 + no community data → submit private (commercial tier) or local sandbox
Pivot on contacted IPs to find C2 → block at firewall
Pivot on dropped files → search EDR for those hashes on other hosts

blocks.text: Privacy warning: anything you upload to VT is shared with paid subscribers. For sensitive corporate samples, use private/enterprise tier or internal sandbox.
